analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($490.47) vs SMA5 ($490.38)/SMA20 ($507.23)/SMA50 ($514.35) — below short-term and mid-term trends.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($411.87)/SMA200 ($317.08) — strong long-term trend.
· 52-week position (78.4%) + current price level near historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (46.5→48.0) + exiting oversold, continuing consolidation in neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-10.1685→-2.4948) + improving, confirming bottoming process.
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $507.23) + band width at 26.32% indicates moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($460.21) + based on Pivot (PP) at $496.23.
· Swing resistance ($546.44) + breakout confirms uptrend resumption.
· 5-day high ($530.13) < 20-day high ($574.20) → Lower High pattern, indicating weakness.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.33x) + low confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + conditions for observation met.
